title: Red Fire Engine Wee Oo | Lalu Saves the Kitten - Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
Lalu hears a kitten crying high up in a tree and rushes to help with his red fire engine!
This fun rhyme teaches kids that helpers are brave and that everyone feels safe when we work together.
Sing along, clap your hands, and go wee oo!

Mew, mew, mew, up so high
Here comes Lalu, right now!
Red fire engine, wee oo, wee oo
Here I come, I'm coming to help
Zoom, zoom, zoom, zoom
Lalu's on his way!
Up, up, up, up goes the ladder high
The little kitten climbs down, wee oo
Down, down, down, into Bhaiya's arms
Safe and sound at last, hip hooray!
Clap your hands, clap your hands, all the kids clap along
Mew, mew, says the kitty
Thank you, thank you, thank you so much
What a happy, happy day!
Wee oo, the kitty is safe
Lalu rides back home
Honk, honk, honk, honk
Bye bye, bye bye, see you soon!
